result:
I've written round 239 as `current-task.md`: **SABA-B-11b stage 1, the zoom-adaptive grid**. `b-next.json` says **CONTINUE**.

**Round 238 result.** C passed it in the browser, `browserVerified: true`, 0 bugs. Gate 238 published rounds 237 and 238 together as `15a0b41`. From that evidence I closed seven findings in `backlog.json`: C-R237-01, A-R237-REVIEW-L1, A-R234-REVIEW-M1, B-R235-READY-CLOBBER, GATE234-S2, GATE234-S3 and C-R236-02. SABA-B-11a is now complete. The old task is copied unchanged to `tasks/round-238.md`.

**New findings from the gate-238 reviewer.** I rated GATE238-S1/S2/S3 Low and moved them to `deferred_low_polish`:
- S1: the "Loading the demo collection…" text is no longer announced at mount. It is still shown, and the ready text is announced a second or two later.
- S2: doc 185 and the code disagree on one load-failure case that `/studio-lab` can't reach.
- S3: the tempo-seed text is announced twice.

I also ruled on A's slow-test note. LRS4 is at 53 % of the default timeout; the next round that owns `library-row-strings-ui.test.tsx` gives it a declared timeout. The reviewers' architecture note on the status line went into addendum 4 of the checkpoint request. It stays non-blocking, and I set "before SABA-B-10a" as the point to ask again.

**Why 11b now.** No Medium or higher bug blocks new scope. The regression round is due from 2026-10-30, and the next RETRO is at round 245. 11b comes next in Saba's order. I split it into two stages:
- **Stage 1 (round 239):**
  - adaptive grid by default for both the seconds and musical grids;
  - `5` switches between adaptive and fixed;
  - `1`/`2` change one of five density levels;
  - picking a division makes the grid fixed;
  - zooming writes no status.
- **Stage 2 (round 240):** `4` as a Snap key, Adaptive/Fixed items in the grid menu, and no snapping to grid lines that are hidden.

**The pre-check changed the design.** I built the change on a copy outside the repo and ran the full test suite on it:

| Rule tested | Result |
|---|---|
| Lines at least 20 px apart | 83 tests red in 13 files |
| Lines at least 24 px apart | 2 red (string lists) |
| 24 px plus the granted test edits | 3,044 of 3,044 green |

24 px is the WCAG minimum target size, and it keeps today's 1 s grid at the default zoom.

One visible change comes with it: a 120 BPM track at the default zoom now shows a 1/2 grid instead of 1/4. I put this in the task, and in `backlog.json` under the next regression round so that check doesn't expect 1/4. In real Chromium at both viewports, the copy behaved as planned.

**Scope for A.** A may edit 13 files; everything else is hash-frozen, including all protected auth and purchase files. Six existing test files change only their expected values, with no assertion removed. `/studio-lab` stays the anonymous demo, and the grid code doesn't touch audio.

**Questions for Saba** (none blocks the round):
- **SABA-Q-11B-READOUT:** Live shows the grid size bottom-right; ours stays in the grid control at the top-left. Move it?
- **SABA-Q-11B-DENSITY:** is 24 px between lines the right density? Live doesn't publish its value.
- **SABA-Q-11B-PLAIN-DIGITS:** we use plain `1`–`5`, not Ctrl+digit, because Ctrl+digit switches Chrome tabs. OK?

The advisor was available and I used it twice: once before writing and once at the end. I applied its fixes to the task, the backlog and the reports. The store tree is unchanged at `15a0b41` with a clean status.

Sources:
- [Ableton Live 12 manual, Arrangement View 6.10 "Using the Editing Grid"](https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/arrangement-view/)
- [musicgurus: The Grid in Ableton Live (Isaac Cotec)](https://www.musicgurus.com/courses/create-new-parts-audio-midi-in-ableton-live-online-course-with-isaac-cotec/lessons/the-grid-ableton-live)
- [Elephorm: adaptive grids in Ableton Live 12](https://www.elephorm.com/formation/ableton-live-12-edition-des-clips/maitrisez-les-grilles-adaptatives-dans-ableton-live-12)
